name: combat-5: combat-1 and combat-4 together (the axes on the edged side, and physical strikes read weapon weakness)
why: The order question between 52-review-combat H1 and 44 R6: does repairing the table first keep the melee ways together once strikes read weakness. It targets pace.

edits.to: const dmg = (m) => { const hh = inst.heroes && inst.heroes[u.id]; const vs = !el && m && m.side === 'mon' && hh && typeof hh.rollsVs === 'function' ? hh.rollsVs(rowOf(inst, m.kind), m.kind) : null; const wk = vs && vs.weak && vs.weak.matched ? 1.2 : 1; return roll(sc, hitRange(Math.max(1, Math.floor((Number(u.maxHit) || 1) * wk)), row)); };

edits.from: const r = landHit(inst, sc, u, m, dmg(), el, hitTag, sg);
edits.to: const r = landHit(inst, sc, u, m, dmg(m), el, hitTag, sg);
